outputs.explanation: Panel A is a stacked area/bar chart showing median state frequencies across continuous log2 Pol II ChIP-seq bins (n=5912 promoters aggregated into many bins). Given the continuous binning and stacked-area rendering, it behaves like a line/area plot rather than a discrete few-category bar chart; overlaying thousands of individual promoter values would make it unreadable, so it falls under the line-plot style exemption.

Panel B is a single-molecule stack (heatmap-like raster) where each row represents an individual DNA molecule's methylation pattern. The state frequency percentages shown on the sidebar are directly derived from and displayed alongside these individual single-molecule data, so individual data points are effectively shown.
Same representation as panel A (mouse data): a stacked area/bar chart of median state frequencies over continuous Pol II ChIP-seq bins, exempt for the same reasons as panel A.
Same representation as panel B (mouse Skp1 locus): individual single molecules are shown as rows in the stack, providing the individual data underlying the summary percentages.

Panel E is a box plot comparing PIC occupancy across groups; box plots already display the data distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, and outlier points), so this is exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual points.
Panel F is a box plot comparing Pol II occupancy across groups; box plots already convey distribution information and are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
